notes.title: We are incredibly proud to announce: OFFICIAL RELEASE HAS HAPPENED!
notes.notes: [p]We are incredibly proud to announce: OFFICIAL RELEASE HAS HAPPENED![/p][p]Our hardcore platformer Gold for Retirement is already waiting to break your nerves into splinters![/p][p]Forget about a quiet old age![/p][p]Here you will find:[/p][p]➜ Deadly saws and spikes that love unexpected encounters.[/p][p]➜ Dozens of sophisticated levels[/p][p]➜ Tough but fair gameplay in the spirit of legendary platformers.[/p][p]➜ Stylish pixel graphics and a bombastic soundtrack.[/p][p]Will you be able to collect enough gold to finally relax? Or will retirement remain an unrealistic dream?[/p][p]🔥 PLAY NOW AND CHECK YOURSELF! 🔥[/p]
